description: Deployment scale profiles. The selected profile shapes the architecture stage (topology, data, scaling decisions) and the delivery stage (which IaC/hosting to generate) without changing the app's core logic. Select per run with --scale, the dashboard, or FACTORY_SCALE.

startup.label: Startup (cheapest, fastest to ship)
startup.summary: Single small footprint, minimal ops, optimised for cost and speed to first customers.
architecture: Keep it a simple modular monolith; avoid premature microservices
One database (managed Postgres, small/burstable tier); no read replicas
Synchronous request handling; background work only if essential
Basic structured logging and a health endpoint
delivery: Single container app (Azure Container Apps consumption, or App Service B1)
Managed Postgres (Flexible Server, Burstable B1ms) with automated backups
One environment (prod) + a preview on PRs; secrets via env/managed identity
Minimal IaC: one Bicep file + azure.yaml for azd up

growth.label: Growth (scaling users, resilient)
growth.summary: Autoscaling, staging environment, caching and real observability for a product finding traction.
architecture: Modular monolith with clear seams; extract a worker only for clearly async jobs
Managed Postgres (General Purpose) with backups + point-in-time restore; connection pooling (PgBouncer)
Add Redis for caching/sessions and a job queue for async work
Rate limiting on public endpoints; OpenTelemetry traces + metrics + alerts
delivery: Azure Container Apps with autoscale (KEDA rules), min 1 / max N replicas
Redis (Azure Managed Redis) and a queue (Service Bus or Storage Queue)
dev / staging / prod environments; CI/CD gates (tests + scans) before deploy
Modular Bicep; App Insights + Log Analytics wired in

scale.label: Large scale (high availability, enterprise)
scale.summary: Zone-redundant, horizontally scaled, DR-ready architecture for large or regulated workloads.
architecture: Clear service/worker separation; async-first for heavy paths; idempotent handlers
Postgres with read replicas + pooling; caching tiers; consider partitioning/sharding for hot tables
CDN for static assets; API gateway with rate limiting, WAF and auth at the edge
Full observability (traces/metrics/logs/SLOs), graceful degradation and circuit breakers
delivery: Azure Container Apps (multi-replica, zone-redundant) or AKS if orchestration is needed
Zone-redundant Postgres + read replicas; Managed Redis (clustered); Service Bus
Front Door/CDN + WAF; multi-region or documented DR/runbook and backups
Modularised Bicep/Terraform, network isolation (VNet + private endpoints), Key Vault for all secrets
